metadata.title_tag: WebCatalog: Organize Apps Without Losing Account Context
metadata.meta_description: Evaluate WebCatalog for multiple apps and accounts: compare workspace needs, plan limits and one real client workflow before moving everything.

hero.headline: Give each client a clearer workspace
hero.subheadline: WebCatalog is a candidate for people organizing several web apps and accounts. Evaluate it with one client workflow before moving everything. The decision is whether its desktop apps, profiles and spaces make your own work easier to navigate.
hero.risk_reversal: Check current terms and suitability before committing.
hero.answer_snippet: WebCatalog is a candidate for people organizing several web apps and accounts. Evaluate it with one client workflow before moving everything. The decision is whether its desktop apps, profiles and spaces make your own work easier to navigate.

problem_solution.problem: Which account and project should be open right now?
problem_solution.agitation: Adding another tool is only useful if the arrangement remains understandable when work is interrupted.
problem_solution.solution: Start with one project and a short list of daily tasks. Compare completing those tasks in your existing browser setup with completing them in WebCatalog.

benefits.benefit_description: List the apps, accounts and project groups you need before choosing a plan.
Decide whether you need a personal arrangement or a shared setup maintained for colleagues.
benefits.feature_supporting_it: Shared spaces appear in the Business plan

benefits.benefit_description: Try one representative workflow and note any login, notification or navigation problems.
benefits.feature_supporting_it: Basic has 2 desktop apps, 2 profiles and 1 space

proof_blocks.summary: WebCatalog's official comparison lists desktop apps, profiles and spaces for macOS, Windows and Linux. Basic includes 2 apps, 2 profiles and 1 space; Pro removes these limits; Business adds shared spaces and team management.

how_it_works.title: Choose a representative project
how_it_works.description: Use a project with two accounts you regularly confuse. Record the tasks you need to complete.

how_it_works.title: Build a small arrangement
how_it_works.description: Name each account and project clearly. Check that you can recognize the active context before sending or editing anything.

how_it_works.title: Compare a normal work session
how_it_works.description: Record setup effort, interruptions and resource usage on your own device. Keep your existing setup if the new one adds friction.

limitations.limitation: Installation still needs an IT review
limitations.mitigation: Ask IT to assess access, installation and data-handling requirements before introducing another desktop application.

limitations.limitation: A browser may already be sufficient
limitations.who_it_affects: People using few apps or one account
limitations.mitigation: Compare with your current browser profiles before paying for a separate workspace tool.

objection_handling.objection: What would make this a poor fit?
objection_handling.response: Compare with your current browser profiles before paying for a separate workspace tool.

cta_blocks.label: Explore WebCatalog
cta_blocks.supporting_text: Use your own workflow to make the decision.

faq.question: Will it use less memory than my browser?
faq.answer: We have not measured that. Compare the same apps and workload on your own device; do not assume an app container is lighter.

faq.question: Should I choose a shared setup?
faq.answer: First agree who maintains it and which client accounts may be included. Then verify that the current plan supports your collaboration needs.

faq.question: What is the review based on?
faq.answer: This review uses official documentation checked on 13 October 2026. The workflow checks are editorial suggestions, not test results.
